about_the_game:
The The Labyrinth Of Sublime Terror Saga, or the LOST Saga, is an ambitious MMORPG game that plunges you deep into the eerie and mysterious realities of the Backrooms. Our game is designed to balance exploration, survival, co-op gameplay, a truly unique storyline, and character customization.

Our Vision

Our goal is to create an immersive multiplayer experience in an online virtual world that captures both the unsettling nature of the Backrooms and horror games while still fostering a dynamic narrative and player-driven cozy experience. Blending horror, survival, solo, and multiplayer elements seamlessly for the purpose of creating an engaging experience.

What Sets The LOST Saga Apart From Other Games

Expansive Backrooms Universe

  • Featuring meticulously hand-crafted Backrooms Levels, The LOST Saga brings the familiar Backrooms environments with a unique twist that you won't find in any other game!

Player Progression and Customization

  • Customize your character with unique outfits while you uncover the universe's lore and navigate through levels full of puzzles, entities, and hidden exits around every corner!

Parties and Guilds

  • Playing alone isn't fun! Use our online servers to play with your friends, or make new ones, and join guilds like The Major Explorer Group (The MEG), or form parties with your friends to complete puzzles and collect materials!

Trophy System And Achievements

  • Earn trophy rewards on your Steam Profile for completing tasks, finding Levels, and so much more!

Expanding Content

  • Updates will come as a "Chapter" system. Currently, there are six (6) chapters planned for the mainline story. There are several others planned for after the conclusion of the main story, essentially functioning as a postgame.
